name: H&M Sweden Automation Use Case Development
description_detailed: Developed multiple processes in UiPath Studio which assisted users in automating reports on missing items, updating active items and markets, and cleansing personal information from vouchers in accordance with the EU GDPR.
Analyzed and integrated the GraphQL API by Centra.
Deployed the processes using Azure DevOps and worked closely with the client during deployment and hyper care phase in case of issues.

name: Advanced Travel Insurance Chatbot using Kore.AI and ChatGPT integration
description: EY GDS Philippines - Proof of Concept
description_detailed: Trained on the Kore.AI platform, where we managed to create a chatbot that assists with checking, recommendations, and reviews of travel insurance policies.
Utilized Kore.AI’s integration with ChatGPT to give personalized responses to chatbot users and created an API that processes documents from PDF to text.

Worked with team members to integrate our assignments, and to provide a demo to company leads regarding the potential of the platform, as well as to showcase what we have learned regarding the use of GPT.

name: LeanIX Data Extraction and Reporting System
description_detailed: Engineered the back-end for this web application where we were tasked to extract data from the client’s LeanIX environment using the GraphQL API.
Worked on producing an equivalent report based on what is seen on the web application using LaTeX.
Interacted closely with the Australian client to immediately work on action items whenever any drastic changes occurred.

name: Data Engineering Reporting
description: EY GDS Philippines - Proof of Concept
description_detailed: Trained on the Microsoft Azure platform, specifically Azure Data Factory and Databricks, to produce a proof of concept.
Followed the Extract, Load, and Transform process to clean up and format data retrieved from a mock database.
Utilized Microsoft PowerBI to create a dashboard that will show the compilation of the cleaned-up data, as well as show some important statistics.

name: Mercury Extract - Pending Timesheet Report Data [EY GDS Timesheet notification system (via teams)]
description: EY GDS Philippines - Operations Team - Proof of Concept
description_detailed: Together with a teammate, developed a process in Power Automate that extracts data of employees who lack time logs for the current week, and then sends out a detailed report of the dates and times they are lacking to both them and their direct superior.

Consulted with multiple teammates as well as the client department regarding how to improve the process as this is an internal project that will be used by a different department and applied the necessary changes seamlessly.
Created detailed documentation regarding the use and troubleshooting of the automation, as well as providing continuous support should there be any further improvements.

name: EY GDS Badge Notification System
description: EY GDS Philippines - Learning and Development Team - Proof of Concept
description_detailed: Trained in the UiPath platform to produce industry-level automation, as well as to produce a proof of concept that solidifies readiness for certification.
Engineered a process in UiPath that extracts employee data from Microsoft PowerBI and identifies which employee resources are non-compliant with the yearly learning requirements.
Consulted with teammates and the client regarding process improvement, as well as efficient handling of client requirement changes.

name: Ayala Sureseats Theater Booking Application
description_detailed: Engineered the payment structure for the online website using Paymongo’s online payment API.

Developed, debugged, and assisted with several functions including but not limited to sitewide search, guest login, seat map control, general UI improvements, and various functions in the application’s backend API.
Assisted in debugging the application’s existing Content Management System and fixing newly added functionalities.

name: POS System for Mekeni Food Corporation using Odoo
description_detailed: Modified a point-of-sale system in the Odoo platform, and developed several new functions requested by the client in compliance with BIR rules and regulations.
Worked closely with the quality assurance team, as well as the project manager regarding the generation and debugging of multiple reports and documents produced by the application.
Applied customizations on the interface for the POS System as requested by the client.

name: TextSimEngine: A text-based game engine for the web
description_detailed: A self-project made for the purpose of completing the university’s Special Problems course.
Developed a web application to create a game engine that allows text-based games to be created without significant coding.
Made a paper regarding the findings on how much impact the study had on users who didn’t have any coding experience.

name: MAKIBIS - Makiling Biodiversity Information System
description_detailed: Worked as a back-end developer for this internship together with fellow student teammates, where we developed a new web application for a CodeIgniter application used as the information system for the Makiling biodiversity database.

Developed multiple features for the back-end, including integration of Google login to the application; assisted the front-end with some design concepts, and performed the final integrations between the back-end and front-end.

Aside from student developer teammates, collaborated as well with biological sciences students to verify the integrity and accuracy of the data samples, and published a paper with the results on Academia.edu.
